key_terms: 1. Direct Method: mean = sum(fi * xi) / sum(fi).
2. Assumed Mean Method: mean = a + sum(fi * di) / sum(fi), where di = xi - a.
3. Step-Deviation Method: mean = a + h * (sum(fi * ui) / sum(fi)), where ui = (xi - a) / h.
Mode of grouped data: Mode = l + ((f1 - f0) / (2*f1 - f0 - f2)) * h, where f1 is frequency of modal class.
Median of grouped data: Median = l + (((n / 2) - cf) / f) * h, using cumulative frequencies.
Empirical relationship between measures of central tendency: 3 * Median = Mode + 2 * Mean.
